name: Voxel Builders
hook: Build a block world together. It remembers.
how: Walk around a little island and place and break blocks in eight colors. Bots build trees and houses beside you, and the world is still there the next time you come back.
controls: WASD and mouse, click to place, right-click to break, 1 to 8 for colors, or the on-screen stick and buttons
uses: The world is remembered by the players who built it: whoever comes back first brings it back for everyone.
The host's browser checks every block placed or broken; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots wander the island and build trees, houses and towers until enough people join.
Every block and every builder shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a day and night cycle
Add a creative mode where you can fly
